estimates.assumptions: 1.25 kg raw skin-on bone-in chicken pieces (mix of legs and breasts); approx. 220 kcal, 22 g protein, 14 g fat per 100 g edible raw chicken
2 tablespoons olive oil (28 g total); all oil is used in the recipe
3 cloves garlic, chopped (approx. 9 g); negligible fat
Pinch of saffron threads (approx. 0.1–0.2 g); nutritional contribution too small to estimate reliably
125 ml dry sherry; approx. 86 kcal per 100 ml, alcohol calories included
200 ml chicken stock; approx. 15 kcal, 3 g protein per 100 ml (typical low-fat stock)
1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves (approx. 3–4 g); nutritional contribution too small to estimate reliably
50 g raisins; standard nutritional values for dried fruit
2 tablespoons pine nuts (approx. 18 g); standard values for toasted pine nuts
Handful of fresh parsley (approx. 10–15 g); nutritional contribution too small to estimate reliably
